<think>
The compilation error arises because liquibase.util.StringUtils was removed in Liquibase 4.x. The new version repackages StringUtils under liquibase.repackaged.org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils, which still provides the trimToNull method. The client code imports liquibase.util.StringUtils and uses StringUtils.trimToNull, causing the "cannot find symbol" error. To fix this, we only need to update the import to the new repackaged path. No other code changes are required since the method name remains the same. This minimal change keeps functionality intact and resolves the compilation issue.
</think>
```java
<<<<<<< SEARCH
import liquibase.util.StringUtils;
=======
import liquibase.repackaged.org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```
